titolo: Alaska Is Hiding Something Most Americans Never Notice

scene.testo: Alaska has more coastline than all other US states combined.
Most Americans have no idea how big that really is.
Here is what the map is quietly hiding.
Alaska is more than twice the size of Texas.
Yet fewer than a million people live here.
Much of it has no roads at all.
Planes are the school bus, the ambulance, and the mailman.
Its glaciers number in the thousands.
Some are slowly carving valleys right down to the sea.
Denali towers above everything else in North America.
But that is not the strangest part.
In summer, the sun barely sets in the north.
In winter, the sun can vanish for weeks.
And the sky answers with green fire.
Stay with me, because the biggest surprise is still coming.
